patterns.note: Content is presented in a centered, single-column layout with generous horizontal padding, creating a focused and airy feel.
An extremely oversized, bold, and custom-designed display typeface is used for the main product name, creating a strong visual anchor and brand identity.
A strictly monochromatic palette of white, black, and light grey is used throughout, emphasizing clean lines and the 3D rendered visuals.
Sections and individual content blocks (like form examples and feature lists) subtly fade in or slide up as they enter the viewport.
Sections are visually separated by alternating background colors between pure white and a very light grey, providing subtle visual breaks without harsh divisions.
Prominent 3D rendered illustrations are integrated as hero imagery and within feature sections, acting as key visual elements alongside text.

technique_notes: Uses CSS keyframe animations to trigger subtle fade-in and slide-up effects for content blocks and illustrations as they scroll into view, enhancing engagement without distracting from the content.
The primary display heading utilizes a custom or highly stylized font to create a unique brand signature, contrasting dramatically with a clean, modern sans-serif for all other text.
Monochromatic 3D rendered objects are employed as hero and section illustrations, providing a tactile and sophisticated visual aesthetic that complements the minimalist design.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold display heading (~5-6x body) with clear, legible sans-serif for body and labels, creating a strong typographic hierarchy.
design_tokens.radius: Rounded (buttons, input fields, cards, and section containers maintain a consistent, soft corner radius).
design_tokens.spacing: Airy (generous vertical and horizontal padding, especially in the hero and between sections, creating a spacious and uncluttered feel).

standout: The site's distinctive use of a massive, custom-designed display typeface for the main product name, combined with high-quality, monochromatic 3D rendered illustrations, creates a unique blend of bold artistry and minimalist functionality. The visual impact of the typography and 3D elements is truly memorable.
